submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production single animation frame attack E 05/12 for 06 thunder caster boy. Draw one newly painted 1024x1024 RGBA sprite on true transparent background. Reference 1 is identity and asymmetric costume/props; Reference 2 is the authoritative E facing-right idle, camera, body/head proportions, canvas scale and floor root. Reference 3 is approved clean bright rounded richly rendered Daoist chibi hand-painted style only; do not reproduce its UI.
Frame pose: contact phase of a short forward staff jab toward screen RIGHT. Keep exactly one pointed golden thunder staff tightly in anatomical RIGHT hand, exactly one rectangular golden Taiji talisman in LEFT hand held tucked against chest/rear side. Shift torso forward by joint movement about 12 degrees, knees flexed and feet planted at idle floor root x540 y940. Right shoulder reaches forward and right elbow almost straight, right hand near x720 y585; staff points diagonally right and slightly upward, weapon tip near x940 y480. Body head remain around idle scale; no resizing or recentering; no run forward. Front foot holds ground, trailing heel slightly raised. Determined eyes looking RIGHT, mouth small focused. Ivory-gold Daoist robe navy trim, gold lightning pattern navy trousers, black gold boots, brown layered short hair high little ponytail gold band with turquoise beads. Keep long ornate gold spearhead, round Taiji ornament, turquoise beads and staff shaft consistent with idle; grip correct and fingers coherent. Robe tails and hair lag slightly back left. Full character and all accessories inside canvas with at least 25px transparent margin, hair roughly y130 and soles around y940. This is independently drawn attack key pose, not idle copy, not mirror/warp/interpolation. No lightning, particles, projectile, spell circle, shadow floor, scenery, text, frame label, border, extra limbs or extra props. Preserve genuine alpha.
